name: Engine cooling: jacket-water system, radiator, cooling tower, heat exchanger, circulating pumps
description: Engine cooling: jacket-water system, radiator, cooling tower, heat exchanger, circulating pumps | Cooling water / cooling towers (open and closed) and heat rejection | Closed-loop jacket water / HT and LT circuits, expansion and monitoring

specifications.basis: Jenbacher J920 FleXtra CHP module; heating-water circuit with 70C return and 90C+ hot water for ~94% total efficiency
Jenbacher cooling system (radiators) BOP: sufficient surface area and cooling capacity, easy cleaning; special coatings/materials near coast; special soldering/heating for extremely cold environments
Jenbacher Type 6 CHP module, up to; engine and alternator on frame, control panel, gas train, heat exchangers including exhaust-gas heat exchanger

specifications.metric: Cooling tower with heat exchanger; water treatment obligations
specifications.basis: Cummins Gas Power Plant Application Manual A049Z057 section 3.1.9.2; Figure 24 'Tower cooling system connection to generator set'
specifications.value: Cooling towers typically used with heat exchangers; chemical water treatment, make-up system, discharge and special maintenance must be planned

specifications.metric: Closed-loop cooling process water consumption (data-centre application)
specifications.basis: Wärtsilä Data center power solutions: closed-loop cooling with water-to-air radiators keeps process water consumption near zero; 'consume less than 5 liters (1.3 gallons) of water per hour'

specifications.metric: Ambient operating range / altitude (same closed-loop plant)
specifications.basis: Wärtsilä Data center power solutions: full power from -45 C to 50 C; 100% output above 1,200 m altitude
Cummins Gas Power Plant Application Manual, section 3.1 cooling system introduction
specifications.value: maintain temperature at design flow, maintain design pressure, accommodate expansion/contraction/overfill/loss, provide vent path for entrapped air, provide fill/drain/sample points
